resources.string: Merges Wi-Fi, mobile signal and battery into a single iPhone-Duo style trio glyph in the status bar.
Tap the part of the icon you want to change
Tap a part and pick a component to put there; press and hold to change its size and colours.
The clock is fixed in the capsule; its size and weight can be adjusted.
Remove optional components from this area; the ring and battery bar stay.
%1$s is set in %2$s; the charging bolt takes priority while charging. Select Normal to preview it.
%1$s is set in %2$s; select Charging or Fast charging to preview it.
%1$s is set in %2$s; there is no Wi-Fi in this preview. Select Normal to see it.
%1$s is set in %2$s; this preview currently shows %3$s. Change the preview state to see it.
This component does not fit in the %1$s.
Changes the battery and signal the preview shows, and the three areas follow.
The master switch is off: the preview still draws the style you pick, but the status bar will not.
This part has no size or colour of its own.
Master switch; turn off to restore the stock battery and signal icons.
The ring is the default; the rectangular one puts a column of signal dots on each side of the centre; the capsule uses its own outline as the battery gauge.
Draw the Wi-Fi arcs; the number of arcs follows the real signal level.
Draw four level dots for mobile network signal strength.
Draw two rows of dots instead of one: SIM 1 on top, SIM 2 below. Applies with two SIMs only.
Show the battery percentage inside the ring; replaced by a bolt while charging.
Turn off to drop the bolt from the ring and keep the system\'s own charging icon.
Where the network type label goes: off, inside the ring, or drawn separately outside it.
Where the mobile signal reading lives: inside the ring keeps the level dots, outside moves it beside the battery icon.
Draw the reading yourself while it is outside the ring: bars for one SIM, dots for the other.
With two SIMs, draw only the reading of the SIM that carries data.

Overall height of the out-of-ring reading, in dp. The default is 15dp - the same height as the status bar\'s own signal icon - and the slider covers 6–20dp. The same row is drawn at the same size whether or not the dot row follows it.

The gap between the out-of-ring reading and the battery icon, in dp. The default is 2dp and the slider covers 0–16dp. The gap is reserved: widening it pushes the native icons over by the same amount, so the reading can never land on top of them.
Show the charging power beside the battery icon, from the battery\'s own current and voltage; below 10W one decimal is kept.
Show the battery temperature beside the battery icon, in whole degrees Celsius, stacked with the charging power.

The whole icon as a percentage of the box the status bar gives it; 100%% by default. That box is only about 20dp tall, so the slider can only shrink - 100%% means "as large as the system allows". Every stroke, arc and digit shrinks by the same factor, so the shape is unchanged.

The two readings as a percentage on top of their adaptive size; 100%% by default. With one reading on that size is the out-of-ring type size; with both on it has already been brought down to one icon height, and this scales that answer up or down.
How heavy the two readings are drawn; 700 by default, 100-900. A heavier face is taller, so the combined size is worked out again to keep the two lines inside one icon height.
Enlarge the percentage into the middle of the ring; the top notch goes to dual-SIM, then the Wi-Fi arcs, then the in-ring type.
Pick colors for low battery, charging and critical battery.
Set the color used when the status bar sits on a dark or a light background.
Restore the three state colors to their factory presets.
All three state colors go back to their factory presets; your custom colors will be overwritten.
Switch to the low battery color below this percentage.
Stroke width of the battery ring.
Thickness of the battery bar along the bottom.
Stroke width of the Wi-Fi arcs.
Stroke width of the Wi-Fi arcs, and the height of the group inside the top slot.
Font size of the battery percentage. While centred it is enlarged at most 1.4x, so 38 and above no longer grow.
Stroke weight of the battery number, 100 lightest to 900 heaviest.
Font size of the time in the capsule\'s left slot, independent of the battery number.
Stroke weight of the time, 100 lightest to 900 heaviest.
Font size of the 3G/4G/5G label in the ring centre.
Font size of the 3G/4G/5G label shown outside the ring, in dp; the default is 14dp and the slider covers 8–26dp. The preview cell below is its only reference.
The gap between the out-of-ring type label and its outer side, in dp. The default is 2dp and the slider covers 0–16dp. Under RTL the whole row mirrors.
The gap between the out-of-ring type label and its inner side, in dp. The default is 2dp and the slider covers 0–16dp. It mirrors under RTL too.

When the network type ends in an A (such as 5GA), the size of that trailing A as a percentage of the main label\'s, sharing its baseline. The default is 65%% and the slider covers 50–100%%; 100%% stops the shrink. Applies both inside the ring and outside it.
Stroke weight of the network type, 100 lightest to 900 heaviest.
Opacity of the unlit parts of the glyph.
Write verbose output to the LSPosed log. Enable only when diagnosing.
